title: Must‑Have airports released in MSFS 2024! Sabiha Gökçen, Samoa & More
description:
🔍 Description
This week’s Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace Update (31 January 2026) brings a fantastic lineup of new airports and sceneries for MSFS 2024 on PC. From massive international hubs to remote island strips, this update is packed with must‑have destinations for every virtual pilot.

✈️ New airports added this week (PC)
The following airports were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 NMG Simulations: FAKN Kruger Mpumalanga International Airport (Gateway to South African safaris)
🛫 msfscenerybuilders: KILM Wilmington International Airport (Coastal North Carolina hub)
🛫 msfscenerybuilders: KJOT Joliet Regional Airport (General aviation favorite)
🛫 msfscenerybuilders: KLOT Lewis University Airport (Ideal for training flights)
🛫 msfscenerybuilders: KLPR Lorain County Regional Airport (Midwest regional flying)
🛫 msfscenerybuilders: LCEN Ercan International Airport (Northern Cyprus entry point)
🛫 BEAUTIFUL MODEL of the WORLD: LIPR Rimini San‑Marino Airport (Adriatic coast gem)
🛫 MXI Design: LTFJ Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen Airport (Major Turkish hub)
🛫 DXR Simulations: MMSM Felipe Ángeles International Airport (Mexico City’s secondary airport)
🛫 KiwiFlightSim: NSAS Ofu NSFQ Fitiuta Manua Islands (Remote island ops)
🛫 KiwiFlightSim: NSFA Faleolo International Airport, Samoa (Pacific long‑haul and regional)
🛫 ACO Design Studio: ROAH Naha Airport (Okinawa’s main airport)
🛫 Paulo Ricardo: SBJV Joinville Airport (Scenic Brazilian approach)
🛫 Paulo Ricardo: SBPS Porto Seguro Airport (Brazil’s vacation destination)
🛫 Paulo Ricardo: SBSP São Paulo Airport (Busy domestic hub)
🛫 LuchoDev: SCAR Chacalluta International Airport (Northern Chile route)

🌆 New sceneries added this week (PC)
The following sceneries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🌆 DreamScenery: Helsinki New Lights 2024 Exclusive Edition (Enhanced city night environment)
🌆 dominicdesignteam: Ho Chi Minh City Landmarks (Iconic Vietnam skyscrapers and structures)
🌆 SamScene3D: Kuala Lumpur Mega City (High‑detail city skyline overhaul)
🌆 DreamScenery: LOWW Airport Lights 2024 Edition (Better lighting for Vienna)
🌆 DreamScenery: LPFR Airport Lights 2024 Edition (Improved lighting for Faro Airport)
🌆 DreamScenery: PHNL Honolulu Airport Lights 2024 Edition (Lighting upgrade for Hawaii)
🌆 Ironsim: Tallinn City Landmarks (Estonia’s capital in sharp detail)

If you enjoyed this breakdown, don’t forget to like the video, subscribe for more MSFS content, and let me know in the comments which airport you’ll be flying to first!

✈️ See you in the skies!
